system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for the proof that the double of any natural number is even. It extends the main proof specification and overrides the natural number set with a finite range so that TLC can check the theorem for a bounded set of values.
actors_and_components: There are no actors. This module inherits the mathematical definitions from the base specification.
model_bounds: The natural number set is overridden with the finite range zero through one million. The theorem from the base specification is assumed as a constant-level assumption for model checking.
additional_assumptions: This module assumes the theorem holds and uses the assumption to enable TLC to process the specification. The override replaces the infinite natural number set with a bounded finite set.
